title: Flatsmonster Inshore Fishing
specs: Target species include redfish, snook, tarpon, mangrove snapper, Spanish mackerel, and trout
Fishing techniques include live bait under floats, free-lining, chumming, and plug casting
Fishing locations include inlets, bridges, jetties, sand shoals, grass flats, beaches, and docks
Snook permit required for snook fishing

services.name: Fishing Report
services.desc: Reports from the boat - where the fish are holding, what they are eating, and which tide to fish. Written by Capt. Tyson. Fall snook season is open. Current size and bag limits, where the fish are holding, and what else is worth targeting around the passes this month. Bait is thick in the Intracoastal and the low tide before sunrise is the best two hours of the day. Where to be, what to throw, and when to quit. Deep holes hold the biggest fish of the year, the bridge shadow lines fish well after dark, and recent rain has the trout and redfish switched back

includes: Live bait caught prior to pick up
blurb: Guests fish for species like redfish, snook, tarpon, mangrove snapper, Spanish mackerel, and trout inshore and nearshore waters. Trips include use of all fishing equipment, tackle, flies, artificial lures, and live bait caught prior to pick up. Fishing techniques include live bait under floats, free-lining, chumming, and plug casting around structures and flats.

quotes.author: Alex N. Tripadvisor
quotes.text: There’s a big difference between a captain and a guide. A guide will point you in the vicinity and a captain will put you on real fish — not small fish you can catch off a dock… Tyson could’ve put us on small fish, but he completely changed locations by pulling his boat out of the water and launching in a different spot… We absolutely smashed it with at least 10+ monster redfish, several large snook and my daughter finished the grand slam by adding trout. We enjoyed it so much the first day that we went back the day after.

quotes.author: Dan W. Google review
quotes.text: Tyson worked his magic once again putting us on to some big redfish. Started out as a tough day, and the fish wouldn’t seem to bite at anything. Tyson stayed on the move and eventually got us into a spot where the bite was non stop for a good couple of hours. Best guide in the bay! Definitely check him out. You won’t be disappointed.

Captain Tyson put us on some nice fish… when my grandson landed a 33″ snook and we boated many other snook, a large sea trout, a redfish and some big cats I thought the day turned out great. Captain Tyson was great with my grandson… This trip was perfect for anyone wanting to experience true mangrove fishing for many species.

quotes.author: David P. Tripadvisor
quotes.text: A true Professional. Always on time, bait wells full, top notch equipment, and courteous. Tyson’s knowledge of the area and ability to put you on fish, lots of fish, is unbeatable. With only two of us fishing, we landed and released 60+ Redfish and several Big Snook.

quotes.author: Anthony M. Google review
quotes.text: I’ve had the pleasure of knowing and fishing with Tyson for over 15 years. The amount of knowledge I’ve gained from fishing with him cannot be put into words. He is an absolute class act professional that can flat out fish. A trip with him is well worth it.

We caught fish from the word go! We had a 7 year old with us and he had a blast! I caught a huge redfish, the 7 year old caught a massive snook. We caught around 30 fish total. Tyson was an awesome guide I highly recommended his service.
